purpose: Evaluate and calibrate the exact cluster-aware marginal absolute-FNR non-inferiority analysis before it is frozen for W0.

estimand.positive_direction: higher FNR in the shift/later cell

candidate_analysis.mean_model: Gaussian identity-link GEE with independence working correlation; algebraically OLS for the marginal risk difference
candidate_analysis.variance: Kauermann-Carroll / CR2 bias-reduced cluster sandwich under the independence working model
candidate_analysis.degrees_of_freedom: number of independent provenance clusters across the two compared cells minus 2
candidate_analysis.noninferiority_pass_rule: one-sided 97.5% upper confidence bound for the marginal absolute FNR difference is strictly below 0.03
candidate_analysis.boundary_policy: if corrected variance is zero/non-finite, leverage is invalid, or degrees of freedom are non-positive, the confirmatory NI result is not estimable and cannot pass

absolute_fnr_ceiling.candidate_analysis_if_value_is_supplied: one-cell marginal FNR using the same KC/CR2 cluster sandwich, Student t with G-1 df, and a one-sided 97.5% upper bound
absolute_fnr_ceiling.important: this design-method record does not choose the ceiling

power_simulation.method: Monte Carlo simulation applying the exact candidate NI analysis to every generated replicate
power_simulation.clustered_binary_generator: beta-binomial random-intercept construction with prespecified marginal FNR and Bernoulli ICC
power_simulation.preservation_power_scenario: true absolute FNR difference below 0.03; zero difference is evaluated explicitly
